autoConfig.title: One-Click Model Setup
autoConfig.subtitle: Paste your API key — the model and endpoint are detected for you.
autoConfig.textareaLabel: Paste API key (model name and endpoint optional)
autoConfig.placeholder:
Just paste it, e.g.:
sk-xxxxxxxxxxxxxxxx

A whole block works too:
deepseek
model: deepseek-chat
https://api.deepseek.com
autoConfig.hint: Parsed locally only. The key is never sent anywhere except that provider.

autoConfig.evidenceKeyPrefix: Key prefix {{value}} belongs to this provider
